## Checks
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest -q` and `pytest -q -m slow` pass
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Security-sensitive paths (vault, console security, audit, statistics) reviewed by the owner
- [ ] Docs, ADRs and the readiness checklist updated if behavior or status changed
- [ ] Dependency changes regenerated the lock files (`pip-compile --generate-hashes`)
